```{r , include=TRUE, echo=FALSE}

setwd("/Users/tanxinliu/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversityofSouthernCalifornia/wgs/mutationalsig")
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(caTools)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)
new <-  fread("/Users/tanxinliu/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversityofSouthernCalifornia/wgs/Results/new.csv") 
assign <- fread("Assignment_Solution_Activities.txt")
#change the samples name 
assign <- assign %>%
  mutate(Samples = str_sub(Samples, 7))
assign$Samples=as.numeric(assign$Samples)
assign[assign == 0] <- NA

not_all_na <- function(x) any(!is.na(x))
assign <- assign %>% select(where(not_all_na))



new2 <- merge(x = assign, y = new, by = c("Samples"), all = TRUE)
names(new2)

#recode sample id 1:35
char_vector <- sapply(1:35, function(x) paste0(x))

sampleid <- as.array(char_vector)
new2$sampleid <- sampleid



```


```{r, echo=TRUE}
rm("longnhigh","longnlow","nhigh","nlow","lhigh","llow")
new2$sbstotal<- NULL


new2$sbstotal<- NULL
new2 <- new2 %>% group_by(Samples) %>%
  mutate( sbstotal =sum(c_across(SBS1:SBS89), na.rm = TRUE))
    
summary(new2$sbstotal)

nhigh <- new2 %>% filter(smok==1)
nhigh <- nhigh %>% arrange(sbstotal)
longnhigh <- gather(nhigh,sbstype,sbscount, SBS1:SBS89, factor_key=TRUE , na.rm=TRUE)

longnhigh$Samples <- as.character(longnhigh$Samples)

longnhigh$Samples <- factor(longnhigh$Samples, levels=unique(longnhigh$Samples))

longnhigh <- longnhigh %>% arrange(sbstotal)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
lhigh<- ggplot(longnhigh, aes(fill=sbstype, y=sbscount, x=Samples))+
  geom_bar(position='stack', stat='identity')+theme_minimal() + 
  labs(x='Samples', y='Number of mutations in each signature', title='Numer of mutations in each signature\nin high tobacco exposure samples')+
  scale_fill_discrete(name="SBS\nsubtype") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 0.5, vjust=.4))

lhigh
 

nlow <- new2 %>% filter(smok==0)
nlow <- nlow %>% arrange(sbstotal)
longnlow <- gather(nlow,sbstype,sbscount, SBS1:SBS89, factor_key=TRUE , na.rm=TRUE)

longnlow$Samples <- as.character(longnlow$Samples)

longnlow$Samples <- factor(longnlow$Samples, levels=unique(longnlow$Samples))
     
llow<- ggplot(longnlow, aes(fill=sbstype, y=sbscount, x=Samples))+
  geom_bar(position='stack', stat='identity')+theme_minimal() + 
  labs(x='Samples', y='Number of mutations in each signature', title='Numer of mutations in each signature\nin low tobacco exposure samples')+
  scale_fill_discrete(name="SBS\nsubtype") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 0.5, vjust=.4))

llow



```




```{r, echo=FALSE}
#merge longnhigh longnlow

longnlow$Samples <- factor(longnlow$Samples, levels=unique(longnlow$Samples))
longnhigh$Samples <- factor(longnhigh$Samples, levels=unique(longnhigh$Samples))
longtotal  <- rbind(longnhigh,longnlow)

library(RColorBrewer)
nb.cols <- 18
mycolors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Set2"))(nb.cols)
library(expss)
longtotal <- apply_labels(longtotal, smok=c("high tobacco exposure"=1, "low tobacco exposure"=0))

longtotal$Samples  <- factor(longtotal$Samples, levels=unique(longtotal$Samples))
pdf("rplot.pdf",width=10)
ltotal <- ggplot(longtotal, aes(fill=sbstype, y=sbscount, x=Samples))+
  geom_bar(position='stack', stat='identity')+theme_minimal() + 
  scale_fill_discrete(name="SBS\nsubtype") +
  labs(x='Samples', y='Number of mutations in each signature', title='Numer of mutations in each signature in each sample')+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 0.5, vjust=.4))+scale_fill_manual(values = mycolors)+facet_wrap(~smok,scales = "free")
ltotal

dev.off()

ltotal
```
